spanish: Y lo darás delante del velo que sobre arca del testimonio, delante de la cubierta que sobre el testimonio, que me citaré a ti allá.

findings.issue: Niphal imperfect 1cs of יעד is the speaker meeting or being appointed toward the addressee; «me citaré» adds self-citation/self-summons and makes the speaker the object.

notes: The other tokens, including both verbless על clauses and לך as «a ti», stay within the packet.
